priceSnapshot.note: THE RECLAIM WAS GIVEN BACK, THE BREAKDOWN FAILED, AND THE TAPE IS BACK WHERE IT STARTED. Spot 64,340.1 against endday's 64,440.0 - down 99.9 points, -0.16%, in six and a half hours, and +1.17% on the 24-hour. The number is small and it hides two events that both matter. FIRST, endday's reduce line at 64,225.2 FIRED. Three consecutive 1H bars settled under it - 02:00Z at 64,106.2, 03:00Z at 64,182.5, 04:00Z at 64,219.5 - which is not a wick, it is the settled-close mechanism the report specified, three times. SECOND, it did not follow through. The lowest print of the window was 64,039.0, which stopped 59.3 points above endday's resting stop at 63,979.7, and price has since recovered to 64,340.1, back above the trigger. A reduce that fires and immediately reverses is a failed breakdown, and failed breakdowns are constructive. What is NOT constructive is the level the whole evening was built on: the daily ema50 sits at 64,361.8 and spot is 21.7 points UNDER it. Endday's single new structural fact - the daily ema50 reclaim - has been handed back.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below $64,039.0 - the low of the window since the endday stamp and the floor of the overnight shelf. It sits 71.6 points under the 1H ema20 at 64,110.6 and 16.8 points over the 15m ema100 at 64,022.2, so a settled close through it breaks the fast-EMA stack that has supported every bar of this recovery and opens the $509,519 liquidation shelf at 63,900. The line rises 59.3 points from endday's stop at 63,979.7 because the overnight held and the floor is now a tested level rather than a projected one.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 4H close above $64,630.3 - the 24-hour high, which is also the top of the realized liquidation map. The gate is UNCHANGED from endday because it was not met: the 00:00Z 4H bar settled 64,182.5 and the 04:00Z bar is still forming. Nothing of size prints above 64,630.3 on the burn map, so a settled close through it leaves price in genuinely thin territory. Repeating a gate that has not fired is not stubbornness - lowering it after a failed test would reward the failure.

The institutional half of the move stopped being an assumption tonight. Position stays ADD but small: 5 USDT of the 12.02 available, because the wallet is already 94% deployed and the daily ema50 is overhead, not underfoot.

etfFlows.note: THE LIGHT CAME ON. Farside's Bitcoin ETF table now carries a 17 August row and it is POSITIVE: +$137.3m. That ends three consecutive negative sessions - 12 August -$61.1m, 13 August -$131.1m, 14 August -$56.2m, totalling -$248.4m - and it is the first verified dollar of net new US spot ETF demand since 11 August. This matters more than its size. For four consecutive reports the desk has said the same thing: the derivatives tape showed a real buyer while the spot creation channel showed nothing, so the institutional half of the move was an assumption. It is no longer an assumption. The qualifier is that one +$137.3m session does not make a trend, and it arrived on the same day BTC ran roughly 1,900 points off the 16 August low - so it may be a chase rather than a lead. Watch whether 18 August confirms.

calibration.note: The prior report is 2026-08-17-endday, published at 19:42:00-05:00 with spot at 64,440.0. Its reduce line at 64,225.2 DID fire, and it fired properly - three consecutive 1H bars settled beneath it at 02:00Z 64,106.2, 03:00Z 64,182.5 and 04:00Z 64,219.5, on the settled-close mechanism endday specified rather than a wick. Its add gate at 64,630.3 did NOT fire; the 00:00Z 4H bar settled 64,182.5, 447.8 points short. Acting on the reduce would have HURT: a sale at roughly 64,225.2 marks against spot 64,340.1, a loss of about 114.9 points or 0.18% of the reduced size. Endday's resting stop at 63,979.7 was NOT touched - the session low of 64,039.0 stopped 59.3 points clear - so the overnight protection cost nothing and did nothing, which is the correct outcome for a stop. Two other endday claims should be marked honestly. It reported the 1H ema50 crossing above the 1H ema200 for the first time; on this run's 299-bar measurement ema50 is 63,756.1 and ema200 is 63,778.3, so the cross is not present. It called the daily ema50 reclaim at 64,366.4 the single new structural fact of the session; the daily ema50 now measures 64,361.8 and spot is 21.7 points under it, so that fact has been handed back within seven hours. Set against those, the two things endday could not verify have since verified: open interest rose again, and the ETF creation number printed positive. The lesson is narrow and worth keeping - a reduce line can fire correctly and still be the wrong trade, because a level that is broken and immediately reclaimed is information about strength, not weakness.
